identity.name: Submariner Date
identity.one_liner: The aluminum-bezel Submariner Date of 1988-2010, the longest-serving modern Sub.

narrative.story: The 16610 carried the Submariner Date through 22 years with the caliber 3135, a sapphire crystal, and an aluminum bezel insert that fades with wear rather than staying showroom-new. Its long run and high production make it the most accessible route into a discontinued Sub, and late examples overlap the first years of the ceramic 116610.
narrative.collector_notes: Check the lug holes (pre-circa-2003 cases have them, later cases do not), insert fade and originality, and whether the bracelet is the earlier hollow-end-link 93150 type or the later solid-end-link style. Serial-era consistency matters for full sets.
